newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA NOT INTERESTED IN LITIMPEKS.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA NOT INTERESTED IN LITIMPEKS.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Thursday it does not plan any investments into Lithuania's Litimpeks Bank at present.
"We have never highly valued the opportunity of investing into Litimpeks," Targo Raus, Tallinna's council vice chairman, told Reuters, adding that no investment decisions will be made today.
Litimpeks has been negotiating with potential investors, including Tallinna Pank, to sell its new 60 million litas shares issue.
Raus said neither additional negotiations nor any deals have been made lately with Litimpeks.
Tallinna Pank, the fourth largest bank in Estonia, is looking for opportunites to enter Lithuania's banking market.
